## Checklist

- [ ] One library per pull request, in `Libraries/<Name>`, named after its package
- [ ] `python Build.py Libraries/<Name>` passes
- [ ] I tried it in Manimator run on my computer, pointed at my branch (CONTRIBUTING.md), and its objects and
      animations draw and play as intended in the editor
- [ ] It renders in Manim Community on a computer too (for example from Manimator's Download)
- [ ] `author` is my GitHub user name and `license` is `MIT`
- [ ] It's my own work, or copied only from code whose license allows MIT
- [ ] A change to an existing one has a new `version`
